name: eddy-nado
overridesComment: RainbowKit renders QR codes through cuer, which calls the qr package with border:0. cuer declares a loose 'qr':'~0' range, and qr@0.6.0 started rejecting border<=0 — so the QR screen throws 'invalid border=0' and white-screens the app. Pin below that until cuer tightens its range.
